description: Calculate totals for a list of items. Use when needing subtotal, discount, tax, and total. Do NOT use for creating invoices; use create_invoice instead.

discount_pct.description: Discount rate as a percent, e.g. 10 for 10%

items.description: List of items, each with name, quantity, and price

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate as a percent, e.g. 8 for 8%

name: calculate_totals

discount_amount.description: The total discount applied to the subtotal.

subtotal.description: The sum of all item prices before any discounts or taxes.

tax_amount.description: The total tax applied to the subtotal after discount.

total.description: The final amount after applying discount and tax to the subtotal.

title: Calculate totals
